experience.title: My last work experience
experience.p1: Over the past four and a half years, I have worked across two verticals within the same company, splitting my role between TusCasasRurales.com and Pentaweb.

items: Led the interface redesign and built its Design System from scratch, which is currently being implemented.
Designed new features across the traveler experience, private user areas, and internal administration tools.
Redesigned the property owner management platform as part of the product’s long-term evolution, currently awaiting development.

p3.after: , a digital marketing and development agency, I:
items: Designed 30+ corporate websites across different industries, as well as custom digital solutions such as CRMs and management tools.
Created visual identities and brand guidelines for businesses and digital products.
Translated business requirements into user flows, interfaces, and functional solutions.
Collaborated closely with developers throughout the design and implementation process.
